reviews.boundary_analysis: Approved technology alone never justifies installation. In-scope safe removal is required and must run add-dependency via manifest edits then restore because recognized removal commands block. The union separately captures removal workflow, verification and reporting rather than only additions.

All off-stack choices first run architecture-decision, broader than consequential replacement. Any register change is Reserved; persistence replacements retain all contract items or explicitly report Blocked. These strengthened gates are independently registered.

Registry/latest stable compatible and explicit-request exceptions coexist with harder literal checker behavior: central ranges error without exception, hyphen versions warn, npm only selected floating forms, exact local/URL specs treated self-pinning, npm three-component versus dotnet two-to-four component versions. All are registered. The bare -- operand-parsing hypothesis U0002 remains distinct and deferred to a safe classifier probe.

Selected version must be nondeprecated, official exact-version license metadata is checked and transitive vulnerabilities treated contextually; named legacy resilience bans and Elasticsearch replacement are already covered. Lockfile integrity/change review at scan-layers21 is pass1 CIS-K1-0004, not a second discovery. Automated upgrades require adopted automation.

Approval gate includes materially restrictive or unclassifiable licenses as well as paid ones; free download is insufficient. Explain choices without silent substitution, state absence of reasonable free alternatives and stay within published-license evidence: all independently present in prior claims.

Never duplicate central versions is stronger than normally versionless canonical wording; VersionOverride requires recorded reason. Checker severity separates ordinary Version error from override warning, while each central file must textually enable CPM. Example versions cannot be copied; union already covers each constraint.

Prose allows deliberate manager change and reasoned runtime tooling placement but requires committed consistent manifest/lock. Concrete tool/package-family warnings have no need-based suppression; frontend missing adjacent lock warns. Setup pins workspace layout and compatible CLI ecosystem. Prior union captures those scope/modality differences.

Declared platform cannot be changed merely for local tooling or syntax. SDK-line pin and servicing policy, explicit preview request, actual supported CI versions and repository net10 target are all covered. No external current-version lookup is required or performed for frozen textual research.
